goal.raw_text: To enable the Auctioneer to edit currently running or scheduled auctions and find product for editing or removal.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer is using the View / Edit Current & Scheduled Auctions page.
The auction to be edited or removed is a currently running or scheduled auction.
The Auctioneer uses the View / Edit Current & Scheduled Auctions page to find product for editing or removal.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer uses the View / Edit Current & Scheduled Auctions page to find product for editing or removal.

claims.content: The Auctioneer selects "View / Edit Current or Scheduled Auctions" from the Administration Menu.

Under the search results, the Auctioneer selects an option from the scrolling "Action" list box: "Remove checked items from this auction", "Edit durations", "Edit bid increments", "Edit reserve amounts", "Apply ending time to all", "Apply starting time to all", or "Create grouping / event".
When applying ending/starting times to all, the Auctioneer chooses the time from the dropdown list in the column header.
The Auctioneer can select one of the available event profiles (but no more than one), and click on an "Apply" button.
At main flow step 1, the Auctioneer may check the "Choose All" checkbox under the search results and under the "Action" column.
At main flow step 1, an alternative action is to select "Remove checked items from this auction" from the scrolling "Action" list box.
At main flow step 1, an alternative action is to select "Edit durations" from the scrolling "Action" list box.
At main flow step 1, an alternative action is to select "Edit bid increments" from the scrolling "Action" list box.
At main flow step 1, an alternative action is to select "Edit reserve amounts" from the scrolling "Action" list box.
At main flow step 1, an alternative action is to select "Apply ending time to all" from the scrolling "Action" list box.
At main flow step 1, an alternative action is to select "Apply starting time to all" from the scrolling "Action" list box.
At main flow step 1, an alternative action is to select "Create grouping / event" from the scrolling "Action" list box.
At main flow step 2, when applying ending/starting times to all, the Auctioneer should choose the time from the dropdown list in the column header.

At main flow step 1, instead of selecting an action from the scrolling "Action" list box, the Auctioneer can select one of the event profiles from the available event profiles list box, but no more than one, and click on an "Apply" button.

If the Auctioneer's action would result in an auction with the same starting and ending date/time, the system displays an error message and highlights (color-codes) the offending data; the exception path exits after the error message and highlighting are presented.

The selected action from the scrolling "Action" list box has been carried out: checked items have been removed from this auction, durations have been edited, bid increments have been edited, reserve amounts have been edited, ending time has been applied to all, starting time has been applied to all, or a grouping/event has been created.
If an event profile was selected, the selected event profile has been applied to the selected items.
